name: Copyparty
short_description: Self-hosted file server with resumable uploads and media streaming.
description: Copyparty is a feature-rich self-hosted file server with resumable uploads, audio and video streaming, file search, thumbnails, and torrent support. Designed for sharing files across devices with minimal configuration and no external dependencies.
usecases: Upload and share files with friends and family on your own server.
Stream music and video from your personal collection.
Search through stored files with built-in indexing and metadata support.
